adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts lines 7-10, the schema uses `[z.string().toString()]: z.number()` which evaluates to a literal string key (the string representation of the zod string schema), not a dynamic property matcher. Zod doesn't support dynamic keys this way - this creates a property with a fixed literal key name rather than matching arbitrary numeric expiry fields. This means the schema won't properly validate real expiry fields like 'expires_in' or 'expiry_date', causing the safeParse to potentially fail or strip important fields. The finding correctly identifies this as a schema construction bug.
